ollamaLocal.label: Ollama
ollamaLocal.description: Your private, local brain! Ollama runs lightweight open-source models right on your machine, keeping your data entirely private and free from cloud costs.

localHardware.label: LOCAL HARDWARE
localHardware.description: GPU and CPU resources dedicated to local inference.

frugallmCore.label: FrugaLLM
frugallmCore.description: The true mastermind of the operation. FrugalLM acts as your central hub, intercepting prompts and dynamically routing them to save you serious money without sacrificing quality!

schemaPath.label: SCHEMA PATH
schemaPath.helpText: Think of this as the agent's strict instruction manual. By giving it a JSON schema, we force the AI to return data in the exact structure your application expects. No more messy text—just clean data!

workingDir.label: WORKING DIR (CWD)
workingDir.helpText: Where should the agent live while it works? This is the folder on your computer where the agent will run commands and look for files. It's basically the agent's home base.

executable.label: EXECUTABLE (BIN)
executable.helpText: Which program is actually doing the heavy lifting? This tells the system what tool to launch under the hood. Usually, it's 'agy' for our Antigravity agent, but you can plug in any CLI tool!

extraArgs.label: EXTRA ARGS (CSV)
extraArgs.helpText: Want to tweak how the agent runs? You can pass secret flags here (like '--verbose' to see its inner thoughts). Just list them out, separated by commas.

prompt.label: INSTRUCTION PROMPT
prompt.helpText: This is your agent's main mission. Tell it exactly what you want it to accomplish. Be as specific as possible—the better the prompt, the better the results!

ip.label: IP ADDRESS / HOST
ip.helpText: Where does this service live on the network? Usually, it's right here on your computer ('127.0.0.1' or 'localhost'), but it could be a cloud API halfway across the world!

port.label: PORT
port.helpText: Think of the IP address as the building, and the Port as the specific door to knock on. It's how our hub knows exactly where to send its messages.

bindAllInterfaces.label: Make available everywhere
bindAllInterfaces.helpText: Allow other computers on your local network (LAN) to connect directly to your FrugaLLM proxy.

startOnLogin.label: Start on Login
startOnLogin.helpText: Automatically start FrugaLLM in the background when you log into your operating system.

globalCli.label: Register CLI commands in system terminal
globalCli.helpText: Allows calling hermes, opencode, and ollama directly from any terminal window.
globalCli.tooltip: Creates shell PATH links for Hermes, OpenCode, and Ollama so you can call them from your external terminal without opening FrugaLLM.

viewLogs.label: VIEW LOGS
viewLogs.helpText: Open the FrugaLLM application log file in your system's default text editor.

apiPassword.label: API PASSWORD
apiPassword.helpText: Require a Bearer token / password when clients connect to your FrugaLLM proxy.

openRouterApiKey.label: API KEY
openRouterApiKey.helpText: Your OpenRouter API Key. This will be securely saved into your operating system's native Keychain!

googleApiKey.label: API KEY
googleApiKey.helpText: Your Google AI Studio API Key. This will be securely saved into your operating system's native Keychain!

vramDetected.label: VRAM DETECTED (GB)
vramDetected.helpText: We tried to auto-detect your Video RAM, but you can correct this if it's wrong.

recommendedModel.label: RECOMMENDED MODEL
recommendedModel.helpText: Based on your VRAM, we'll pull this model for you!

toolGateway.title: TOOL ENFORCING GATEWAY
toolGateway.description: Runs a lightweight local ONNX language model (Xenova/nli-deberta-v3-small) in WebAssembly to detect empty promises and enforce strict tool execution.
toolGateway.installPromptText: The Tool Enforcing Gateway requires downloading the lightweight local ONNX model (Xenova/nli-deberta-v3-small, ~100MB). Would you like to install it now?
toolGateway.uninstallPromptText: Are you sure you want to uninstall the Tool Enforcing Gateway? This will remove the local ONNX model cache and disable tool enforcement.
